data.name: Merri Puzzle
data.detailed_description:
We did it!

Thank you to everyone who voted for Merri Puzzle on green light. I hope everyone has as much fun playing the game, as I did making it.


Acerca do jogo

Merri Puzzle is a physics based puzzle solving game, with a unique look and feel to it. The goal is simple, getting an object, often a ball to the end of a maze. Your only controls are the forces of gravity, and building blocks. There are multiple ways to solve most levels. You can make block slides, block elevators, or just fill in the gaps. Other levels may need you to build walls to help avoid lava, or to get a key shape to the exit. As the game goes on, the amount of strategy required to solve each puzzle will go up. Merri Puzzle features a range of different mechanics. Some exits may be locked, some rooms may require making a path for two shapes to reach each other. Different shapes have different physical properties. Instead of building a bridge with blocks, you may try floating your ball across a sea of other physical objects you generated. Each level is unique with a different challenge. Merri Puzzle includes a simple check-point system. You can pick the way you play with point and click control buttons or key binding macros. This way you can play with a mouse and keyboard or your Steam controller.

reviews.review:
Developed by Merriman Games and published by SA Industry, Merri Puzzle is a physics-driven puzzle experience that focuses on creativity, experimentation, and logical thinking rather than fast-paced action. At first glance, its premise appears straightforward: guide a ball or other objects through a series of increasingly elaborate stages until they safely reach the designated exit. However, the game's mechanics quickly reveal far greater depth, asking players to manipulate gravity and strategically place various building blocks to reshape each environment. This foundation creates a rewarding puzzle experience where observation and planning are often more valuable than quick reactions.

One of the game's biggest strengths lies in how it encourages players to think outside the box. Instead of presenting rigid, single-solution puzzles, Merri Puzzle allows multiple ways to complete many of its stages. Building blocks can function as ramps, barriers, supports, elevators, or bridges depending on where and how they are positioned. As players advance, new mechanics steadily expand the possibilities, introducing hazards such as lava, locked exits that require additional objectives, and puzzles involving multiple objects with unique physical behaviors. These additions ensure that each new set of levels introduces fresh challenges without abandoning the core gameplay principles established early in the adventure.

The physics system serves as the heart of the experience, rewarding experimentation over trial-and-error frustration. Many puzzles invite players to test unconventional ideas, often discovering unexpected yet completely valid solutions. Rather than simply following predetermined paths, players are encouraged to study momentum, gravity, and object interaction to overcome obstacles efficiently. This freedom makes each completed puzzle feel satisfying because success comes from understanding the mechanics rather than memorizing specific solutions. The gradual increase in complexity also creates a comfortable learning curve, allowing newcomers to build confidence before facing more demanding scenarios.

Visually, Merri Puzzle adopts a clean and uncomplicated presentation that prioritizes gameplay clarity. The environments are designed to keep important interactive elements immediately recognizable, allowing players to focus entirely on solving puzzles instead of being distracted by excessive visual detail. While the graphics are modest compared to larger productions, they effectively support the gameplay by making the physics interactions easy to read. The straightforward interface and uncomplicated presentation reinforce the game's emphasis on thoughtful problem-solving instead of visual spectacle.

Beyond its puzzle design, Merri Puzzle includes several features that improve the overall experience. A checkpoint system helps reduce frustration by allowing players to recover from mistakes without replaying lengthy sections, making experimentation feel less punishing. Multiple control options also provide flexibility for different play styles, whether players prefer keyboard controls, point-and-click input, or controller support. Steam achievements further encourage replayability by rewarding thorough exploration of the game's mechanics and progression, giving dedicated players additional objectives beyond simply completing every level.

Merri Puzzle may not appeal equally to every audience. Players searching for a story-driven adventure, cinematic presentation, or action-heavy gameplay may find its slower, methodical pace less engaging. The minimalist visuals and focused design place nearly all of the attention on puzzle solving, meaning enjoyment depends largely on one's appreciation for logical thinking and creative experimentation. Those willing to embrace that philosophy, however, will find a thoughtfully designed indie title that consistently rewards patience and clever problem-solving.

Overall, Merri Puzzle succeeds as an enjoyable physics-based puzzle game that delivers a satisfying blend of creativity and strategic thinking. Its flexible puzzle design, steadily evolving mechanics, and emphasis on player experimentation provide lasting appeal throughout its collection of levels. Although its presentation remains simple and its pace deliberately measured, the gameplay offers enough variety and challenge to keep puzzle enthusiasts engaged from beginning to end. It stands as a solid example of how inventive mechanics and well-crafted level design can create an entertaining experience without relying on flashy production values.

Rating: 5/10
